mission: Frank v0.1 voll lauffähig auf Andreas PC

material_results.finding: Exact V7 typed-fn grammar is strict-LALR blocked before typed-IR lowering by one structural optional-dotted-relation conflict family. Debug localization found six terminals: REQUIRES, SUBSET_OF, OR, IN, IFF and LBRACE, all reducing <dotted_relation : qid DOT_REL>.
material_results.functional_falsifier: Default shift resolution is observably harmful: `rule Needle.owns requires X` shifts `requires` into the optional dotted-relation RHS and then fails, while `rule Needle.owns X requires Y` succeeds.
material_results.consequence: Do not classify the historical WP03 red strict run as a typed-IR regression; V7 itself violates the strict frontend contract.

findings: `rule Needle.owns(X)` is a call under selected V17 but a dotted_relation under V7.
V17 admits hyphenated identifiers; V7 compact `x-y` semantics treat the same characters as subtraction.
A contextual typed-fn extension over V17 can keep `fn` usable as an identifier in identifier positions while admitting `fn ...` declarations at statement start.
material_results.refined_disposition: The existence of a V7 default is not by itself proof that production WP03 uses V7. The remaining blocker question is whether any target/release consumer can silently hit the independent V7 reparsing default. Acceptance paths must bind explicit frontend/surface/grammar identity; otherwise the split remains a blocker.

material_results.finding: Typed-IR name extraction incorrectly treats grammar-admitted keyword spellings such as `status` as globally forbidden names. AST-context extraction is the bounded repair candidate.
material_results.receipt_status: No current WP03_MAIN_AST_CONTEXT_HOSTED_LATEST.json was present at last read; workflow definition is not execution evidence.

material_results.finding: Current frontend semantic_hash distinguishes `rule x>0` from redundant grouping `rule (x>0)` and nested grouping, despite preserved intended meaning. This is an independent WP02 semantic-canonicalization obligation.
material_results.repair_direction: Collapse only grammar-generated grouping-only primary(LPAR, expr, RPAR) nodes for semantic identity, retain syntax/provenance elsewhere, bind/version the changed canonical-hash contract, and keep numeric normalization out until typed semantics prove equivalence.

material_results.finding: A four-file WP02 candidate coupling standalone canonicalizer construction to the production parser contract passed its remote evidence lane, but an attempted exact current-main rebase was stopped when main advanced by 16 commits. Do not hand-port repeatedly from a stale base.
Release promotion now requires manifest repository commit == current checkout HEAD; a coherent old target bundle must not replay into BASE PASS after source drift.

The usable Hostinger self-hosted runner is repository-scoped to gschaidergabriel/Dr.-Unterweger rather than clay-global-research-entity. Clay-repo self-hosted jobs are not valid remote evidence lanes.

out_of_box_experiment.name: PARSER_CONFLICT_EXCISION_TOMOGRAPHY
out_of_box_experiment.result: Removing word-operator identifier aliases eliminates five of six V7 conflicts; eliminating the optional dotted-relation RHS choice eliminates the full conflict family. This localizes the causal structure without promoting a grammar mutation.
